issue_request: FHIR-34023 was a Published FHIR-core-search change request with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked to reword the Patient?general-practitioner.name=Joe&general-practitioner.address-state=MN example to clarify that the two chained parameters are evaluated independently and need not match the same Practitioner.
initial_application: No explicit git commit mentioning FHIR-34023 was found. The older sentence came from the FHIR-14951 chained-search warning, and immediately before the later FHIR-52942 clarification source/search.html still contained the challenged Joe-from-CA/Jane-from-MN wording.
additional_context: FHIR-52942 is a later Applied FHIR-I clarification for the same search-page paragraph. It approved the current, fuller wording that says the query asks for any general practitioner named Joe and any general practitioner in Minnesota, and that a Patient seeing Dr. Joe in California and Dr. Jane in Minnesota matches because result sets are joined at the Patient level. Confluence minutes record the FHIR-I approval for FHIR-52942.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active search page already implements the FHIR-34023 clarification in a more explicit form than the literal 2022 wording, so editing it again would be redundant and risk drifting from the later approved FHIR-52942 text.
